# AL Air Duct Cleaning Jacksonville — llms.txt

## Business identity

- **Name:** AL Air Duct Cleaning Jacksonville
- **Service:** Professional air duct cleaning, HVAC cleaning, dryer vent cleaning, duct sanitization, and mold inspection (with licensed referral for remediation)
- **Location:** Jacksonville, Florida (Duval County)
- **Service area:** All of Duval County, St. Johns County, Clay County, and Nassau County in Northeast Florida
- **Phone:** See site header — available 24/7
- **Website:** https://jacksonville.alairductcleaning.com

## Services

1. Air duct cleaning — NADCA-standard negative pressure source removal cleaning for residential and commercial properties
2. Dryer vent cleaning — full lint removal from machine connection through exterior termination
3. HVAC cleaning — blower wheel, evaporator coil access, air handler cabinet, and duct runs
4. Residential air duct cleaning — tailored to Jacksonville's housing stock including historic homes and new builds
5. Commercial air duct cleaning — offices, retail, restaurants, medical, multi-unit residential
6. Sanitization and deodorization — EPA-registered antimicrobial treatment applied after cleaning
7. Mold inspection and duct cleaning — visual inspection with referral to FL-licensed assessors/remediators for work beyond duct scope

## About this business

AL Air Duct Cleaning Jacksonville is part of the AL Air Duct Cleaning network serving multiple US markets. Jacksonville operation serves the full four-county Northeast Florida area including communities that other providers often decline (Nassau County, outer Duval County, Clay County) without travel surcharges.

Jacksonville-specific conditions addressed: sustained high humidity, heavy pine pollen season (Feb–Apr), historic homes with retrofit duct systems (Riverside, Avondale, Springfield, Ortega), military PCS move-in cleaning (NAS Jacksonville, Naval Station Mayport), coastal salt-air conditions (Jacksonville Beach, Atlantic Beach, Neptune Beach, Ponte Vedra), storm-season water intrusion.

## Florida mold licensing note

Florida Chapter 468, Part XVI requires separate DBPR licences for mold assessment and mold remediation, and prohibits the same firm from performing both on the same project. AL Air Duct Cleaning Jacksonville performs visual mold inspection and duct cleaning. Work requiring licensed mold remediation is referred to FL-licensed professionals.
